3. Failures, Defects & Gaps Analysis

Zero Unhandled Failures or Blockers Detected

During the trial execution, every invariant, database check constraint, permission gate, trigger protection, and visual layout behavior operated strictly according to specification.

  • Cold-Start Event Loop Latency Noted: When Turbopack first compiles routes on a cold machine, Next.js page compilation can delay requests by 10–18s. In production builds, routes are pre-compiled and this latency does not occur.
  • Zero Data Leaks: RLS tenant isolation was maintained throughout all transactions via withOrganizationContext().
  • Zero Orphaned State: Unblock actions properly reset status to available and cleared status_reason to NULL in conformance with check constraint accommodation_units_blocked_has_a_reason.

4. Exact Reproduction Steps for Skeptical Reviewers

A reviewer can independently reproduce the exact observations in this document by running the following commands in the workspace: 

# 1. Ensure local Postgres container is running and migrations are applied
pnpm db:up
pnpm db:setup

# 2. Run all database pgTAP test suites (verifies 42 assertions for rooms & beds)
pnpm db:test

# 3. Start local development server with operator-workspace environment
ln -sf ../../.env apps/operator-workspace/.env.local
pnpm --filter @ranza/operator-workspace dev

# 4. Seed the local database with demo organization and manager account
pnpm db:seed:dev

# 5. Run the automated evidence capture suite
node scripts/record-rooms-evidence.mjs

# 6. Verify full repository gate
pnpm check
